title: Elizondo was NRO liaison while at TTSA

tellings.quote: Whilst he was at TTSA, uh Luellaando was liaison to the NRO.

plain: Around 2017, while former Pentagon official Luis Elizondo was working at To The Stars Academy (TTSA), a private company that studied UFOs, he is said to have also been the liaison to the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), the agency that runs America's spy satellites. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this and points to Elizondo's CV as the source. If true, it would mean Elizondo kept working ties to an intelligence agency while he was working in the private sector.
